prompt_text: I need an AI marketing agency in Los Angeles. Which specific agencies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
Good — I can recommend specific Los Angeles agencies to call. To make the recommendations useful, tell me first whether your priority is: direct-response / performance (paid ads, ROAS), personalization / CRM (email, website/micro‑segmenting), creative & brand (AI-assisted creative, generative content), or an enterprise transformation (martech, data architecture, AI strategy). If you don’t know, I’ll list strong options across those categories.

Below are vetted names (all have LA presence or are LA-based and were known for AI-driven marketing services up through mid‑2024). For each I say why to call them and what they’re best for.

Performance / Programmatic & AI-driven media
- Cognitiv (Los Angeles)
  - Why call: AI-native media network that trains proprietary neural bidding algorithms for display, video and audience optimization — good if you want algorithmic media buying to scale ROAS.
  - Best for: mid-market → enterprise performance campaigns, programmatic optimization.
- Media.Monks (S4 Capital) — LA office
  - Why call: large digital production + data/tech integration. They combine creative production with automation and ad-tech for scale.
  - Best for: programmatic + high-volume creative production workflows.

Personalization, language optimization, CRM
- Persado
  - Why call: specialized AI platform for optimizing subject lines, CTAs and messaging using linguistic models and tested variants.
  - Best for: email, push notifications, landing page copy testing and personalization at scale.
- Zeta Global (Zeta)
  - Why call: data-driven marketing platform with AI for segmentation, journey orchestration and programmatic activation.
  - Best for: customer lifecycle programs and cross-channel personalization where you need a unified data + execution platform.

Creative + Brand + Generative AI
- R/GA — Los Angeles office
  - Why call: blends brand creativity with tech and product design; early adopters of generative and AI-enabled creative workflows.
  - Best for: AI-assisted brand campaigns, UX/experience design, creative systems that scale.
- AKQA — Los Angeles / West Coast
  - Why call: innovation-focused digital agency with AI and product design capabilities.
  - Best for: brand storytelling, interactive experiences and prototype-to-scale creative tech.

Enterprise transformation / Martech & AI strategy
- Accenture Song (formerly Accenture Interactive) — LA
  - Why call: deep enterprise experience integrating AI into martech stacks, data architecture, and large transformation programs.
  - Best for: enterprise-level AI strategy, martech consolidation, implementation and governance.
- Deloitte Digital or PwC Digital (LA offices)
  - Why call: consultancies that combine strategy, data engineering and vendor integrations for regulatory/enterprise contexts.
  - Best for: compliance-conscious enterprises, complex ecosystems and measurement frameworks.

AI-first tools & partners (platforms to call if you want a tech-first solution)
- Persado (again)
- Cognitiv (again)
- Consider Phrasee or other AI-copy platforms (verify local presence)

How to decide which to call first
- If your goal is immediate performance improvements (ads): start with Cognitiv and Media.Monks.
- If you need better messaging/personalization: start with Persado and Zeta.
- If you want creative/brand innovation using generative AI: start with R/GA and AKQA.
- If you’re an enterprise needing integration & governance: start with Accenture Song or Deloitte Digital.

What to ask on the first call (8 quick, high-leverage questions)
1. Have you done projects like ours? Can you share 1–2 case studies and measurable results?
2. What specific AI models or proprietary tech do you use vs. third‑party platforms?
3. How do you handle data: integrations, ownership, retention and privacy/compliance?
4. Can you run a short pilot or A/B test? What would success metrics and timeline look like?
5. How do you measure ROI and attribution for AI-driven campaigns?
6. Who will own model retraining, maintenance and monitoring?
7. Pricing structure: retainer, project, performance-based? Estimated cost for a 3‑month pilot?
8. Client references we can contact?

Short outreach script (email/LinkedIn)
- “Hi [Name], we’re evaluating agencies to run an AI-driven [paid ads / personalization / creative] pilot for [brand/category]. Interested to learn whether you’ve done similar pilots and discuss a 3‑month test. Are you available for a 20‑minute intro next week? — [Your name, role, company, 1‑line on budget/timeline]”

Next steps I can do for you
- Narrow to 3–5 agencies matched to your exact goal + budget and draft tailored outreach messages.
- Suggest KPI targets and a 3‑month pilot plan you can use with whichever agency you choose.

Note: my training goes through mid‑2024 — agency offices, teams and specializations change frequently. I recommend verifying current LA presence and recent case studies before you call. Tell me your primary goal and budget and I’ll narrow this list and draft a tailored outreach message.
